bounded_interpretation: The exact 64 link5 plus 64 gripper count comes from the RRD entity/component and part_idx machine contract, not from visual counting.
The colored collider families are one-way Float32 display copies; D348 callback topology and canonical Float64 JSON remain scientific authority.
The green wire views are the actual Viewer PhysX collider visualization; the colored views are session-only display guides and did not mutate colliders.
The Rerun Float64 metrics pane is visible, but numeric traces are not legible at the selected part_idx; no metric is read back from this screenshot.
The fixed jaw means the retained raw link5 connected component containing the D349 nearest witness, not the gripper_left_link STL hypothesis or legacy 8 mm proxy.
